title: Mississippi Mud and How Happy We Can Be: solos Lester learned
summary: Phillips and Dupre sort out which Mississippi Mud record had Bix's break, and Phillips names How Happy We Can Be from Bix's small group.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: No, that's a big band. We got the solo he played on it. We liked the solo.
Any other ones you can remember?
Let's see... Oh yeah. "Mississippi Mud."
He learned that?
Yeah.
Which group was that?
That was a small group.
That's the one that had a vocal on there?
No, they didn't have no vocal on it. They didn't have no vocals in them days -- they played.
The one I heard had a vocal on it.
Yeah? Was it by Bix?
No, no. He wasn't singing. They had Frankie Trumbauer and maybe even Bing Crosby or somebody singing. But Beiderbecke took a solo on it. Right after the vocal he took a solo.
See, then that must have been Paul Whiteman.
Well, they had some people out of his band. Whiteman wasn't on it.
Bing Crosby and the Rhythm Boys made that with Paul Whiteman.
Phillips - 65
Right. They were in the band. Right. But Whiteman wasn't on this record.
But I'm talking about the one that he made with Paul Whiteman... The Rhythm Boys sing "Mississippi Mud" with Whiteman.
I'm just trying to get it straight which record it was that you said he learned the solo on.
Well...
If you don't remember, I mean...
But I remember the one that was made from Paul Whiteman's band. I don't remember the small band too much. I remember that...
Could you hum a little bit of that solo? Maybe that would help. You said he learned the solo on "Mississippi Mud."
[SINGS] That's the alto player -- the saxophone. The trumpet said, Bix said... [SINGS]... That's Bix's famous break on "Mississippi Mud."
And he learned that, you say.
We bought all of them. I used to play that.
Any other records you can remember?
What is it...? "I love my baby/My baby loves me/When we get married... I love my baby/My baby loves me..." -- that one. [SCATS A BIT]
Phillips - 66
Do you remember the title of that?
"How Happy We Can Be."
Who recorded that?
I think was Bix's combo, the one he made records with. Yeah, because Rollini was there, playing that bass sax.
